g.text: GPT-3.5: action matching and state-change accuracy | n=10
Line: mean; band: query SD (ddof=0), clipped to 0–100%. Seed=42; nested subsets.
Pendulum actions: direct-bin matching. States: 3-class re-analysis of INC/DEC-only responses.
Action parse failures count as incorrect; state parse failures are excluded. Not an exact paper replication.
